title: oasdiff 1.24.0 before 1.34.1 fails to enforce --allow-external-refs=false when --open is used, because the…
description: oasdiff versions from 1.24.0 up to but not including 1.34.1 do not properly enforce the --allow-external-refs=false setting when the --open option is used. This occurs because the internal capture reader in load/capture.go does not apply the external-reference policy. As a result, an attacker supplying a malicious OpenAPI specification can use external $ref references to read local files or trigger HTTP requests, with the retrieved contents included in the review bundle.
